_comment: WO-5 step two: the order infra/gpu/sweep.sh runs (src/training/wo5_sweep.py reads this file). Approved by the
owner on 2026-10-11 (decision register D-052): Secure Cloud RTX 4090, on-demand, up to $0.89/h, six cells
at the 5-pass ceiling. Calibration first; the contingent seed only on a miss; a second miss stops. Then the
cells from the cheapest projected to the most expensive. One training process at a time. Each step is
killed past twice its projected hours; the whole sweep stops at the hard limit (default 42 h, about $37.38
at $0.89/h). Projections live in each cells file's 'projection' block; this file only orders them.
